value.name: files error and refuses to forget it
value.description: Rosa reflects that she filed an error instead of forgetting it, showing she has not let the matter go.
evidence: She had filed it. She had not forgotten it.

value.name: wakes early and makes coffee
value.description: Rosa gets up at five-thirty and makes coffee, establishing her early routine.
evidence: She got up at five-thirty and made coffee.

value.name: shops at the Italian Market
value.description: On Saturday morning, Rosa walks from her apartment to the Italian Market and buys her usual groceries.
evidence: On Saturday morning, Rosa walked from her apartment on Catharine Street to the Italian Market and bought what she had bought every Saturday for thirty-one years, which was a half-pound of provolone, a loaf of bread from the bakery on Christian Street, and a small bag of the small dark olives
value.location_hint: Catharine Street / Italian Market / Christian Street

value.name: keeps groceries for herself
value.description: Rosa brings the groceries home and puts them in her own refrigerator instead of taking them to the Spruce Street house as she used to.
evidence: She brought these things home and put them in her own refrigerator, which was a thing she had not done very often before, because she had been in the habit, for thirty-one years, of bringing them to the house on Spruce Street.

value.name: eats breakfast standing at counter
value.description: Rosa makes breakfast and eats it standing at the counter, unable to sit down for a meal she prepared for herself.
evidence: She made herself breakfast. She ate it standing at the counter
which had become so much a part of her body that she could not, even in her own kitchen, sit down to a meal she had prepared for herself alone.

value.name: Daniel calls Rosa
value.description: At ten o'clock, Daniel telephones Rosa.

value.name: Daniel clarifies personal apology
value.description: Daniel says he is speaking for himself, not through the lawyer or as executor, because he wants to apologize to Rosa.
evidence: "Rosa," he said. "I am calling to ask you something and I want to be clear that I am not asking it through the lawyer and I am not asking it as the executor and I am asking it as myself."
